Automated Description (Alliance of Genome Resources)

(Alliance, FBgn0085200 )
Automatically Generated Summary (FlyBase)

Gene Group (FlyBase)
S1A NON-PEPTIDASE HOMOLOGS -
Serine protease homologs of the S1A family are similar in amino acid sequence to S1A serine proteases but are enzymatically inactive due to the lack of catalytic residue(s). Their functions are generally poorly understood, though at least some of them have known regulatory functions. (Adapted from FBrf0155784 & FBrf0240739.)
